# Academic writing

> How to write a report, a research paper, a mathematical article or a proof: the conventions of each genre, the evidence behind them, and a shape for each, extending reader-ergonomics.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension.

## Standard

- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-academic/standard.md): the one-page card to follow, with every principle and its grade
- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-academic/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository

## Optional

- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-academic/evidence/README.md): one literature review per topic, with the evidence against
- [Bibliography](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-academic/evidence/bibliography.md): every cited work, once
- [Shapes](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-academic/shapes/README.md): skeletons for kinds of documents
